description:
`addUsersToAlbum` fails if any user is already a member

If you call addUsersToAlbum with multiple users and one of them is already a member of the album, the entire request fails rather than adding the remaining users.

Expected: Skip already-existing members, add the rest, return partial results or a clear per-user status.

Actual: Request fails with an error for the duplicate user; no users are added.

tests_added: album.service.spec.ts: should skip if the userId is already added
album.service.spec.ts: should skip if the userId is the ownerId
album.service.spec.ts: should add new users when already-added users are included

evidence: test: album.service.spec.ts: should skip if the userId is already added
test: album.service.spec.ts: should skip if the userId is the ownerId
test: album.service.spec.ts: should add new users when already-added users are included

notes: Report states symptom and expected behaviour (skip existing members) but not the code change; fix replaces throw BadRequestException with continue in AlbumService.addUsers; RC exact. Mild lexical overlap (API name addUsersToAlbum).
